source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed interim financial information 2Q2025 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-3, review report (Forvis Mazars) p.4. Units differ: the statement of profit or loss (p.8, three-month and six-month columns side by side) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. No PAA business, one portfolio (non-participating). Revenue 3.2.1 p.21 and expenses and reinsurance p.22 (three and six months, both years). CSM roll-forward 3.3.1.2 p.27-28 (30 มิถุนายน 2568); new business 3.3.1.3 p.31 (the non-onerous column prints 101 of loss and the onerous column 35 of CSM; totals used). Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). No tax line amount. RA release uses 3.2.1 (LRC basis, 18,309), not the AOC RA (20,506). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the three-month column (p.8).
